status: Implemented; final automated gates in progress

authority.kernel: SurfaceNodeLifetime remains the sole membership witness allocator; no kernel or durable schema change
authority.Canvas: One last-reconciled membership table receives witnesses and retires runtime caches before slot reuse can be observed
authority.Seiche: Graph-free explicit retirement command drops only named body lives and their remembered material/kinds; ordinary sync still retains existing bodies
authority.actor: Atomic retire-and-sync command plus existing command-epoch barrier rejects pre-retirement layouts; this is runtime protocol evidence

fixed: Selected nodes, explicit pins, node state/shape, Mosaic, attention/seeds/offers, role items and pinned/settled/at-rest/return state retire by membership rather than endpoint slot presence
Keyboard/pointer moves are cancelled without sending release or Escape to replacement bodies; historical key-move introspection cannot read a new member
Local strategy/paused positions, regions, scope slots, link display appearances, fold-history selections and context/pending self-link presses lose retired slots
UUID-keyed faces/sizes/sprites/hulls/materials retain D1; same-call UUID recreation now prunes the departed overrides before sidecar export
Strategy graph stamps include membership witnesses; title-only edits and metadata clones preserve cache/action continuity
Physics replacement drops the old Rapier body generation, pins, velocity, colliders and axis locks, plus remembered material/kinds; unaffected bodies retain their handles
Explicit graph switches retire runtime lives even for clones, clear old content-affinity/weighted topology and community worker, and reacquire scope choices by UUID rather than old slots
Affected content-affinity rows retire; installed old affinity forces are removed before replacement bodies can run
preserved_domains: Content-addressed decoded image bytes and deterministic address-derived icon bytes are not a membership cache and retain their own cache policy

Authored exact scope, Fold definitions and Forme cell rosters remain UUID intent. Retiring a runtime hold does not delete that intent; a current Forme application can acquire a new hold for a recreated UUID
Ordinary edits/metadata clones and unrelated member replacements preserve surviving action IDs, selections, overrides, ongoing moves, layout coordinates and physics bodies
No source witness is persisted, allocated by reads, treated as an authorization lease or claimed as durable actor completion

remaining_migrations.done_condition: Trace concrete callers; capture owner/membership provenance at dispatch and validate it at installation, preserving authored UUID intent and current explicit edits.
